messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "injected into a vein by a healthcare provider"
set: ["injected into a vein by a healthcare provider", "tell healthcare provider immediately if given by injection", "take prescribed dose as indicated by healthcare provider", "take exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider", "do not inject into muscle or vein", "healthcare provider gives injection if unable to take by mouth", "never crush or break a tramadol tablet to inhale the powder or mix it into a liquid to inject the drug into your vein", "healthcare provider or adult caregiver", "sprinkle the medicine into a spoonful of applesauce", "valid prescription from licensed healthcare provider", "inform healthcare provider about kidney problems", "inform healthcare provider about liver problems", "inform healthcare provider about thyroid problems", "inform healthcare provider about Asian descent", "give a list of all your medicines to any healthcare provider who treats you", "given in vein"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
